s1.title: Analyze uploaded files and generate conference abstracts
s1.content:
Steps:
• Select the target meeting (ISMRM, RSNA, ER/ECR, or ESC).
• Choose standard analysis for an existing manuscript or creative expansion for a core idea.
• Upload a PDF or DOCX file, or paste the manuscript text.
• Select Analyze to extract categories and keywords, then review the suggestions.
• Choose the suggested abstract type and select Generate.
• Review the conference-formatted output and export it as needed.

Tips:
• Large files take longer; paste the text directly if extraction fails.
• Category probabilities are content-based suggestions and should be adjusted to fit the submission strategy.

s2.title: Configure AI models
s2.content: The site supports Google AI (Gemini) and OpenAI-compatible providers. Open Model Settings, select a provider, enter its credential and models, then save. Credentials remain in browser storage unless the selected provider request sends them to its API.

s21.title: Google AI configuration
s21.content:
• Select Google AI in Model Settings.
• Enter a Google AI API key.
• Select a text model and image model.
• Save the settings.

Use a model appropriate to the required quality, cost, latency, and data-handling terms. Retry later if the provider is temporarily unavailable.

s22.title: OpenAI-compatible configuration
s22.content:
• Select OpenAI Compatible.
• Enter the Base URL and API key for the chosen provider.
• Refresh the model lists and select text, vision, and image models.

Model identifiers and supported endpoints vary by provider. Confirm image-generation compatibility with that provider.

s23.title: Image-model configuration
s23.content: Standard mode edits an uploaded image using supplied specifications. Creative mode uses an existing abstract as context for a new figure. OpenAI-compatible providers may support image generation and vision analysis; Google providers may support Imagen. Image MCP remains a separately configured optional tool.

s24.title: MCP and blind-review configuration
s24.content: In Model Settings → MCP Tools, optional database and image tools can be enabled. Blind review is different: PubMed, CiteCheck, and DOI MCP are administrator-provisioned backend capabilities, so users only enable their checkboxes and never configure endpoints, commands, packages, or tokens. An unavailable backend is reported explicitly and is never treated as verified.

s25.title: Journal styles and schematic layouts
s25.content:
The Image panel includes LANCET, NATURE, NEJM, SCIENCE, JAMA & BMJ, RADIOLOGY, IEEE/ICML/NeurIPS, CELL, and PNAS styles. Selecting a journal and layout synchronizes the visual taste and structural rules shown in Image Specs and used in its structured JSON.

JAMA & BMJ uses restrained British clinical editorial design; RADIOLOGY prioritizes Medical Imaging and diagnostic content; IEEE/ICML/NeurIPS emphasizes algorithms and data flow; CELL emphasizes biological mechanisms and graphical abstracts. Seven layouts cover sequential flow, central targets, input-process-output, nested scales, comparisons, contextual scenes, and modular evidence grids.

s3.title: Abstract storage and synchronization
s3.content: Saved abstracts are retained in browser storage. The Abstract Manager can load, delete, export, and import them. Optional Supabase synchronization may support access across devices when it is configured and enabled.

s4.title: Abstract and image export
s4.content: Abstracts can be exported as Markdown, PDF, or JSON. Generated images can be downloaded in their available image format. Complete and independently verify the content before exporting or submitting it.

s5.title: Member benefits
s5.content:
• New verified accounts receive 5 credits automatically.
• Active daily check-in grants +1; day 7 grants one additional credit, then the streak restarts.
• Members may enable managed GLM-5.2, Nanobanana pro, and GPT-Image models.
• Private cloud storage includes 30 abstracts up to 10 KB each, with credit-based upgrades.
• A matching BYOK configuration takes priority and does not consume member credits.

AI generation and polishing may be inaccurate. Users must independently verify data, ethics, citations, and submission compliance.

ai_disclosure.short_body: AI-assisted analysis, polishing and generation may be inaccurate and do not guarantee compliance or acceptance.
ai_disclosure.title: Serious notice on generative AI assistance
ai_disclosure.no_guarantee: AI output may be incomplete, outdated, misleading or incorrect. This service does not guarantee factual accuracy, originality, regulatory or conference compliance, suitability, acceptance, publication or any presentation assignment.
ai_disclosure.author_duty: The author must independently verify all facts, patient information, methods, sample sizes, statistics, citations, permissions, ethics approvals, registrations, funding, conflicts of interest, commercial balance and the latest official submission requirements.
ai_disclosure.data_transfer: BYOK content is sent to the provider selected in Settings. Member-managed text is processed by the US (iad1) backend and Google Gemini; managed images are processed by that backend and the selected Google Gemini or OpenAI service. Review all applicable privacy and data-use terms before sending confidential or sensitive material.
ai_disclosure.no_fabrication: AI assistance never authorizes fabrication. Missing research facts must remain explicit placeholders until supplied and verified by the author.
ai_disclosure.no_hipaa_guarantee: The service does not certify HIPAA, privacy, research-ethics or legal compliance and does not replace professional, institutional or official review.
ai_disclosure.confirmation: I understand these limitations and accept responsibility for independently reviewing and verifying every AI-assisted output before use.
ai_disclosure.output_body: Accuracy, compliance, originality and acceptance are not guaranteed. Verify all facts, statistics, citations, privacy, disclosures and current submission rules.
ai_disclosure.record_operations: RSNA classification-aware language editing; structure and compliance review
ai_disclosure.copy_reminder: Copy excludes the product disclaimer; author verification is still required before use.
